name: campus-helpdesk-v1
description: Questions about a fictional university, answered from data/kb. Written by the team (synthetic, no licensing issues).

cases.question: When do B.Tech applications open and close?
cases.reference: Applications open on 1 March and close on 30 April every year.

cases.question: What minimum marks are needed in Class 12 for admission?
cases.reference: At least 60 percent marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics in Class 12.

cases.question: Is the application fee refundable?
cases.reference: The application fee is 1500 rupees and it is non-refundable.

cases.question: When are admission results published?
cases.reference: Admission results are published on the university portal by 31 May.

cases.question: What is the annual tuition fee for B.Tech?
cases.reference: The annual tuition fee for the B.Tech programme is 2,40,000 rupees.

cases.question: How much is the late fee after the due date?
cases.reference: A late fee of 500 rupees per week is charged after the due date.

cases.question: Who gets a merit scholarship?
cases.reference: Merit scholarships cover 50 percent of tuition for students with a CGPA of 9.0 or above.

cases.question: What CGPA is needed to renew a scholarship?
cases.reference: Scholarship renewal requires the student to maintain a CGPA of 8.5 every year.

cases.question: How much is the hostel fee and does it include meals?
cases.reference: The hostel fee is 90,000 rupees per year and includes meals in the mess.

cases.question: What time do hostel gates close?
cases.reference: Hostel gates close at 10 PM and students must sign the register for late entry.

cases.question: When are guests allowed to visit the hostel?
cases.reference: Guests are allowed in the visitor lounge between 4 PM and 7 PM.

cases.question: What are the library opening hours?
cases.reference: The central library is open from 8 AM to 11 PM on all working days.

cases.question: How many books can a student borrow and for how long?
cases.reference: Students can borrow up to four books at a time for a period of fourteen days.

cases.question: What is the fine for an overdue library book?
cases.reference: A fine of 5 rupees per day is charged for each overdue book.

cases.question: Which digital libraries can students access on campus?
cases.reference: The library provides free access to IEEE Xplore and the ACM Digital Library on campus.

cases.question: What attendance is required to sit the end-term examination?
cases.reference: Students need at least 75 percent attendance to sit the end-term examination.

cases.question: How can a student request re-evaluation and what does it cost?
cases.reference: Re-evaluation can be requested within seven days of result publication for a fee of 1000 rupees.

cases.question: When are supplementary examinations held?
cases.reference: Supplementary examinations for failed courses are held in July.

cases.question: When does the placement season start?
cases.reference: The placement season starts in August for final year students.

cases.question: Can a student with an active backlog sit for placements?
cases.reference: Students with an active backlog are not eligible to sit for placement drives.

cases.question: Can a student apply to more companies after accepting an offer?
cases.reference: A student who accepts one offer cannot apply to further companies, except dream companies paying above 20 lakh per annum.

cases.question: How often must Wi-Fi passwords be changed?
cases.reference: Wi-Fi passwords must be changed every ninety days.

cases.question: Where is the IT helpdesk and what are its hours?
cases.reference: The IT helpdesk is located in Block C, room 104, and is open from 9 AM to 6 PM.

cases.question: How do I register a new student club?
cases.reference: New clubs can be registered with the Dean of Student Welfare with at least fifteen founding members.

cases.question: When are the technical and cultural festivals held?
cases.reference: The annual technical festival is held in February and the cultural festival is held in October.
